ABOUT AR ENGINEERING

Engineering capability. Built around experience.

The expertise to deliver.
The commitment to do it well.

AR Engineering — Abdul Lathif Mohammed Al Rifae Est. — has steadily expanded its operations across civil, mechanical, electrical and engineering projects in Saudi Arabia. We bring together design, construction, maintenance and technical support, with a commitment to quality and client satisfaction.

Our engineering work follows international standards and specifications, supported by detailed design, experienced teams and active leadership. From project financial control to site management, we focus on careful execution and high-quality finishing. Dedicated teams work alongside clients to support their projects, drive positive technical change and deliver lasting improvements in business performance.

Know More
